en.headline: Five sentenced in ICAC probe of 400 million yen investment fraud
en.dek: District Court sentenced three defendants today to between 33 and 54 months; ICAC is seeking three more foreign suspects in the case involving fake Standard Chartered documents.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption said five defendants were sentenced in the District Court on Monday for their roles in a fraud that used fake bank documents to deceive Japanese investors into putting more than 400 million yen into companies linked to African projects.

Leung Ho-yin, 40, a former Standard Chartered Bank client manager, was sentenced to 45 months and Law Man-fai, 52, a self-employed financial adviser, to 33 months after both pleaded guilty to three counts of conspiracy to defraud. Kam Kit-ching, 58, a manager at ADF Capital, was sentenced to 54 months after being convicted of money-laundering. Two other former Standard Chartered managers had earlier each received three-year terms.

The offences took place between January 2015 and September 2016. Prosecutors said the group issued false fund confirmations and promissory notes that claimed the bank guaranteed ADF for about HK$450 million and that foreign parties held more than HK$37 billion in assets. The deputy judge described the case as complex, involving overseas investors and large sums that damaged Hong Kong’s reputation as a financial centre.
ICAC is seeking three foreign suspects. The agency said it received corruption complaints and launched the investigation that uncovered the scheme.

zh.headline: 廉署揭4億日圓投資詐騙案 五人判囚最高54個月 另通緝三人
zh.dek: 區域法院今日判處三名被告介乎33至54個月監禁；廉署正通緝另外三名外籍涉案人士，案件涉及偽造渣打銀行文件。
body: 廉政公署表示，區域法院星期一就一宗利用虛假銀行文件詐騙日本投資者超過4億日圓（發案時約2840萬港元）的案件，對五名被告作出判刑。
40歲前渣打銀行客戶經理梁浩賢被判囚45個月，52歲自僱財務顧問羅文輝被判囚33個月，兩人早前承認三項串謀詐騙罪。58歲ADF Capital經理甘潔貞經審訊後被裁定洗黑錢罪名成立，判囚54個月。另外兩名前渣打銀行客戶經理早前各被判囚三年。
案情顯示，犯案時間由2015年1月至2016年9月。控方指，涉案人士簽發虛假資金證明書及公司退款承兌票據，訛稱渣打銀行為ADF作擔保人，涉及金額約4.5億港元，並訛稱外籍人士持有逾370億港元資產可用於非洲投資項目。暫委法官鍾明新形容本案複雜，涉及多名海外投資者及跨境投資，金額龐大，影響本港國際金融中心聲譽。
廉署正通緝另外三名外籍涉案人士。署方表示，案件由貪污調查揭發。
